disclaimer: Not medical advice. Disproportionality in spontaneous reports is a screening statistic, not evidence that a drug causes an event: reports are unverified, incomplete and influenced by publicity, litigation and how often a drug is used. Do not use these results to make decisions about any medicine; talk to a doctor or pharmacist.
source: openFDA drug adverse event endpoint (FAERS), https://api.fda.gov/drug/event.json
counting_unit: report (openFDA record = latest version of a FAERS safety report ID); not patients, not drug-event pairs; duplicate reports of one case from different senders are not merged
